name: Watch PR372 after rebase
command:
set old (gh pr view 372 --json headRefOid --jq .headRefOid)
echo "old_head=$old"
while true
    set new (gh pr view 372 --json headRefOid --jq .headRefOid)
    if test "$new" != "$old"
        echo "rebased_head=$new"
        break
    end
    sleep 30
end
gh pr checks 372 --watch --interval 30
echo "checks_watch_exit=$status"
description: Wait for Dependabot to rebase PR #372 onto the golangci-lint fix, then watch all checks to conclusion; no merge action
